description: Various notes, comments, and reflections by Maria Chabot on her marriage to and divorce from Dana Bailey. Three letters from Maria Chabot to Dr. L. Ross regarding the failure of her marriage: June 23, 1961; July 20, 1961; Nov. 15, 1961. Newspaper clippings and popular magazine articles regarding marriage and divorce, found with D. Bailey materials. Most date circa 1963 when dated.
title: Divorce
